features.feature_value: Very short (~3 tokens) with direct insult toward an entire group
features.rationale: The post uses a minimal, blanket derogatory statement targeting a political group.

features.feature_value: Alleges personal corruption/personal benefit as motive; mirrors blame from one politician to another
features.evidence_span: "enables his mafia shakedown" ... "everything else is just a pretext for a grift"
features.rationale: It asserts a cynical causal motive (personal grift) and reassigns it to another figure in the mirror.

features.feature_value: Uses emphatic goal framing and absolutist language (LITERAL GOAL)
features.rationale: The text attributes a totalizing intent to the outgroup using high-intensity emphasis.

features.feature_value: Concedes agreement with one side, then contrasts with past opposition; includes policy domain (gun laws)
features.evidence_span: "to be clear i actually agree with Trump... (regarding red flag laws)" ... "but gun nuts"
features.rationale: The speaker uses a clear concession/qualification followed by argumentative contrast about reactions to gun legislation.

features.feature_value: Quote-and-reframe structure contrasting reproductive rights with gun rights; suggests precedent threat
features.evidence_span: "Maybe because the court was ruling against precedent..."
features.rationale: It embeds quoted phrases and uses a comparative causal explanation pattern.

features.feature_value: Encourages action: push back via conversations with loved ones; supports with named guide
features.evidence_span: "How do we push back... By having fearless conversations with our loved ones."
features.rationale: It directly instructs what to do and offers a resource to help carry it out.

features.feature_value: Uses 'Pre' vs 'Post' framing with a must-do urgency statement
features.evidence_span: "Pre FWS Supreme Court Win:" ... "Post FWS Supreme Court Win:" ... "We must do something!"
features.rationale: The message is organized as a before/after contrast and culminates in an action-oriented imperative.

features.feature_value: Normative justification using personhood/body autonomy framing; abortion policy focus
features.evidence_span: "Even though it is HER body, HER health, and HER life on the line."
features.rationale: It uses moral-justificatory language tied to reproductive rights and bodily autonomy under restriction.
